verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an immigration-services provider can state the basis (case counts, time window, methodology) for any success metric it advertises. The pack shows homepage counters, including an RFE-rate counter and a general 'land visa approvals, fast' claim, but none of the items shows case counts, a time window, or methodology behind them. The Forbes AI 50 '1 in 4' figure names a cohort, but it measures adoption, not approval or success, so it does not satisfy the story.
